thread:
Jess: Hey team — finalizing release notes for the 2.7.1 patch. Quick sync: we need a tiny blurb for the latency fix + note about pinning the model to v2.7.1-rc3.
Sam: I made a 2-sentence summary, dropping it below. Can someone confirm it's accurate?
Sam: "Reduce tail latency for short prompts by fixing the batching edge case. Pin default serving to model v2.7.1-rc3 to avoid regression during rollout."
Leo: Works for me. Suggest we add a one-liner on rollback: how-to fallback to v2.6.8 if the canaries show regression.
Maya: Agree. Add: "Rollback: flip serving-route to v2.6.8 via pin toggle in console; oncall page has steps."
Jess: Good. Ops asks we note the deploy window: tomorrow 02:00–04:00 UTC. We'll run canary 5% for first 20m, then 25% for 20m, then 100% if green.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by Jess for 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Canary policy: [5%,25%,100%], health-checks: latency, 5xx rate.
Oncall: I'll be on standby for the first two hours. Sam — can you own hotfix rollback if needed?
Sam: Yep, I'll be around. I can run the rollback script: 
```
# rollback to pinned model
redwoodctl routes set --service inference --model v2.6.8 --force
```
Leo: Tiny copy suggestion for internal announce: "We’ll deploy v2.7.1 with a staged canary overnight (02:00 UTC). Expect brief traffic shifts; reach out on #eng-oncall for issues."
Maya: Also add the note about release notes link and docs update: /docs/release/2.7.1 and TAG the SDK change in changelog.
Jess: Final checklist for announce thread: attach RN draft, include deploy window, canary cadence, rollback command, and oncall rota. I'll pin the draft at 02:30 UTC after canary passes.
Sam: One last ask — add a short troubleshooting tip: if tokenization mismatch errors appear, restart the worker pool: `k scale workers --replicas 0 && k scale workers --replicas 5`
deploy-bot: reminder scheduled 60m before deploy.
Jess: Great — I'll post the internal announce at 01:30 UTC with the bullets. Leaving the RN draft in the doc now. :thumbsup:
Maya: LGTM.
Oncall: Acknowledge, standby.
